lead.h: India Win Series in New Zealand; U-19s Stun Pakistan
lead.intro: MOUNT MAUNGANUI: India defended just 209 to beat New Zealand by 22 runs in the fifth ODI on Sunday and win the series 3-1, their first away ODI series win under coach Gautam Gambhir.
lead.para: Arshdeep Singh took 3 for 30 and Axar Patel made 46 and took two wickets as New Zealand were bowled out for 187 in 48.1 overs; a 28-run last-wicket stand by Siraj and Arshdeep had lifted India past 200. A day earlier, India’s under-19 team beat Pakistan by one wicket off the final ball to win the Asia Cup, chasing 338 when Mohit Ulwa hit a four. Captain Lakshya made 80 and Aaryavir Sehwag, Player of the Tournament with 361 runs, scored 58. Prime Minister Narendra Modi called it an ‘outstanding day for Indian cricket’.

beside.h: Two tankers hit mines near Hormuz; Iran claims US drone
beside.intro: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said two oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire south of the Strait of Hormuz, and that it shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island. Tehran also rejected Germany’s demand to halt uranium enrichment.

more.h: Special Cell foils extortion plots on actor, businessman
more.intro: Vikas Thakur was held in Delhi and Deep Singh in Mumbai; police say the targets were a Bollywood actor and a Delhi businessman.

second.h: Four Civilians Killed in Ukhrul Ambush; Naga Body Sets Deadline
second.intro: Manipur has ordered every security post to tighten cover and step up combing operations after four Naga civilians were killed in an ambush on the Imphal–Dimapur highway in Ukhrul district on Friday.
second.para: The victims were Kapangkhui Raihing and his mother Haoleila of Shangshak village, and Augustine Ngalung and his sister Tanmila of Tashar village. The Tangkhul Naga Long gave the Centre and the state three days to remove Kuki militants from Naga areas and hand the case to the NIA, warning of an indefinite agitation. Naga MLA Ram Muivah said nine people had been killed in as many months on a 15-km stretch of the highway, and a Kuki woman was killed at Taphou Kuki village on Thursday. Congress MP Christopher Tilak said the party would raise Manipur in Parliament’s Winter Session.

row2b.h: Chhath at 1,400 Ghats as Air Stays ‘Very Poor’
row2b.intro: Delhi’s 24-hour average AQI was 367 on Saturday, a day after it touched a ‘severe’ 403 and ministers ordered half of government staff to work from home.
row2b.para: Seventeen of 59 stations stayed ‘severe’; transport made up 20.5% of the pollution and stubble smoke 13.3%, with 537 farm fires counted across six states. The IMD expects light rain on Sunday from a western disturbance, and the early warning system sees PM2.5 and PM10 easing over two days. The government has readied over 1,400 Chhath ghats, including an 11-km stretch along the Munak canal, with lighting, security and changing rooms for women. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta offers evening arghya at Sonia Vihar on Sunday and morning arghya at Haathi Ghat near ITO on Monday.

lighter.h: Sachin Still Has His First Bat, 49 Years On
lighter.intro: Sachin Tendulkar posted a childhood photo on Sunday holding his first bat, and says he still has it ‘after 49 years’.
lighter.para: The date marks his 1989 Test debut and his last international innings in 2013. On Monday, 26 of his bats, with helmets and jerseys, go on show as ‘Batography’ at the Mumbai Cricket Association’s museum.
